title: F⁴Splat GitHub repository linked
summary: On 2026-07-24, the F⁴Splat development line linked its GitHub repository alongside the earlier March announcement. This is a material public-access milestone because it connects the project to a source repository. The available evidence does not establish which code, version, or implementation changes were present at that date.
